purpose: Learn a distribution of full-context motif codes from isolated-fragment inputs, then use the unchanged frozen unconditional RePaint generator. Native contextual codes are training targets only. This is distinct from failed whole-chain endpoint adapter regression and from failed fragment-anchored full-target re-encoding.
split: Exclude every family in the original 32-protein diagnostic panel. Of the remaining 480 families, reserve four per 128-residue length bucket, ordered by SHA256(seed:family), for descriptive validation; train on all three conditions from the other 464. No labels from evaluation families, no new canonicalization or protein re-encoding. These remain previously used training-corpus proteins, not novel-protein tests.
inputs: Only isolated crop latent8, supplied residue one-hot20, all four isolated atoms in a right-handed middle-residue N/CA/C frame12, and placement/length4. Ablated arm zeros all40 fragment features, retaining only placement/length. No target or full-scaffold input and no scaffold sequence. Rigid-pose controls must preserve features within1e-5. Context targets keep original full-protein encoding/frame.
objective: Rectified flow from independent Gaussian noise to native motif codes, normalized per channel using training targets only. Uniform times, MSE velocity objective. Predict a joint20x8 distribution; do not average endpoint codes. Both arms share initial weights, minibatches, noise, times, optimizer and schedule. Zero-initialized condition and output projections preserve equal initial outputs.
precision: FP32, TF32 disabled; no stochastic dropout. Fixed seed and deterministic algorithms. Small model and all arrays resident on a single GPU. Both paired arms run in one allocation sequentially; no large generator loaded during training.
profile: 40 matched updates, finite gradients, matched draw hashes and initial predictions, nonzero isolated-conditioning gradients, checkpoint/EMA reload parity, changed-fragment sensitivity after training and ablated invariance. Replay saved40-step prefix exactly in full run. Measure peak memory and time before bounding full allocation. Profiles are technical gates, not checkpoint or architecture selection.
validation: One fixed held-out noise/time draw per validation example at initial/final EMA. Report paired flow loss and variance; no best-checkpoint selection. Full final endpoint only. Latent loss is not a designability claim.
generation: After technical qualification sample one independent context-code flow per original scaffold noise slot (four per protein, 50Euler steps), unnormalize and clamp those20 codes in frozen50Euler/AE3/RePaint3 generator. Keep original scaffold/motif/decoder noise streams and seed2026100405. Both arms get identical code noise and scaffold noise. All32 proteins and all128 outputs per arm; no retries, rankings, endpoint averages, overwrites or local closure. Reproduce four original oracle outputs with exact original codes as numerical controls before new sampling.
refolding: Only arms with at least9 raw motif-valid and45 coarse-valid outputs can enter the unchanged full128x8 original-motif-fixed ProteinMPNN/FP32 teacher assay. Reuse all original native/parent budgets unchanged. Count success only when the same valid refold retains the ORIGINAL isolated motif and meets globalTM>.5 and scaffoldTM>.5; also report raw and refold junction connectivity. Preserve all failures and designability separately.
decision: Expansion requires isolated arm >8 strict successes and greater than ablated, at least7 strict families, at least45 designable outputs and no designability loss against ablated. A pass licenses a separately frozen fresh-noise/placement replication only. Failure closes this fixed context-code recipe without duration/checkpoint/threshold sweeps.
resources: Profile one RTX before full training. At most8 own running-plus-pending GPUs, exact registered monitoring, immutable source/data hashes, no data in Git. Locked tests untouched.
